notes.title: Happy Chinese lunar New Year!
notes.content:
As we all know, there is a mysterious lunar calendar in China, and the Chinese lunar new year would always be in between Jan and Feb of the Gregorian calendar. This year, Jan 31st would be the day of the Chinese lunar new year. We also have 12 different kinds of animals as each year’s own zodiac. For this year, is the tiger’s turn now. As shown below, welcome the new “Year of the Tiger”!
Isn't that interesting?
Finally, our Patha Pradipa wish all “You, Calligrapher” players a sparkling, fabulous New Year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40348831/0a8d6382194079b2c61d57daf1ed173bdf09dee6.png[/img]

notes.title: YouCalligrapher 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello YouCalligrapher players. We’ve just released YouCalligrapher version 1.02. This one comes with a list of new stuff and improvement for the base game. Full changelog is below.

—New function of using laser to pick up or place object.
—Add a jade erase pen on the left of the pen holder.

—New function of saving your works in Challenge mode.
—Now players can import songs to the game.
—Now players can import Pictures to the game.
—New Function of Third Personal View function.

notes.title: You, Calligrapher Early Access is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40348831/c41870c53ed7a3120b8fbee1b7e688bc97df4560.jpg[/img]
Early Access is live!

[h2]What's 《You, Calligrapher》[/h2]

《You, Calligrapher》is a VR Calligraphy simulator, in which you can write and draw in ink-painting style.

[h3]What's in it?[/h3]

- A realistic, authentic ink brush physics simulation.
- Over 30 levels of challenges, containng words and phrases.
- A recorded example recorded from Calligraphy master for each word, allwoing you to learn to write like a master.
- Customizable colours that can be mixed by the motion of your dips.
- Saves and seal your works to share online.
- More will be added in the future.

If you are interested, click below to learn more!

notes.title: 《You, Calligrapher》is Comming to Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40348831/e76ef86c96e201cbb004353e0425cb09366d1c0a.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

This is Ron from [b]Patha Pradipa[/b], creators of《You, Calligrapher》.

[b]Patha Pradipa[/b] has been devoting into making VR game for almost 5 years, 《You, Calligrapher》, is our first work to ever come to meet the public.

The game has finally come to publish, I was asked why we developed a Calligraphy simulator instead of Xian Xia or Cultivation game that are more popular and trendy these days.



It reminds me of the first time when I was drawing and writing words with an ink brush(or fur pen), I was 12 years old in a school class, soon after that, my pen and ink were sealed for there's no requirement of that later in the school. Time flies by and now my nephew is 12, her classes teach her coding and English, for they are considered required for future. Not many kid had a chance to meet Calligraphy nowadays.

Therefore we chose 《You, Calligrapher》 as our first title to launch, we want it to be an oppotunity for those who have not get the chance to feel this fascinating cultural art, to be a bridge or even an entrance that will be available even when pens and papers are no longer a thing. 

We are very excited to share this game with you, and we would love to see many calligraphy works written in many languages!

The game will be released to Early Access in Mid-May, and we will be having a Free Playtest before that.
Please wishlist《You, Calligrapher》and join any of our community if that sounds interesting to you.
